name: Spotify

fastest.text: Sign in at spotify.com/account in a browser, open Manage your plan and select Cancel subscription.

steps: Sign in at spotify.com/account in a web browser.
note: Don't see a cancel option? A partner such as your mobile or internet provider bills you. Check Payment under Manage your plan and contact them.

faq.a: Premium stays until your next billing date, then your account switches to the free plan. If you cancel during a free trial, you move to free right away.
No. Your playlists and saved music stay, and you can keep listening on the free plan with ads.

faq.q: I'm on a Family or Duo plan. Can I cancel?
faq.a: Only the plan manager can cancel. Members can leave the plan, which takes them off it but doesn't cancel it.
